Built-in word clearing

Small definitions, useful understanding

This first local collection demonstrates the intended dictionary shape. Each word can later expand into multiple meanings, etymology, idioms, synonyms, and individually cleared senses.

be

A0

Used to say who someone is, what something is, how someone feels, age, job, nationality, or location.

I am Ana.She is happy.They are at work.

English uses be for identity and temporary states. Many languages split this meaning into two or more verbs.

from

A0

Shows origin: the place where a person, thing, or action begins.

I am from Mexico.This message is from Ana.

In introductions, learn the whole chunk: I am from + country or city.

name

A0

The word people use to identify a person, place, or thing.

My name is Ana.What is your name?

At A0, learn the useful chunk my name is before analyzing the noun.

Aligned to the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). Hour estimates and GSE ranges are indicative guides, not guarantees.
